versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00153, SRS_Rte_00189 If the swCalibrationAccess of a VariableDataPrototype used in an Nv- DataInterface of a non volatile data port of a SwComponentPrototype is set to readOnly or readWrite and RteMeasurementSupport is set to true the RTE Generator shall create a McDataInstance element with • symbol set to the C-symbol name used for the allocation (see also [SWS_Rte_07197]) • flatMapEntry referencing to the corresponding FlatInstanceDescriptor element of the VariableDataPrototype
